comparison.objective: Commission a damper, versus replace a latched CR2032 server battery.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses a hex bit, bounded torque, collar adjustment, and repeated physical testing; record uses latch depression, spring-assisted extraction, polarity-aware tilted insertion, and snap retention.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires compliant repeated stops within travel and force limits. Record requires correct cell removal/insertion and latching, with loose-board or dropped cells permanently scoring zero.
comparison.reason: Small-scale contact manipulation is shared, but battery extraction and snap-in insertion test different abilities from tool-mediated adjustment and iterative damping response.
